global_rules.confirmatory_correction: Holm across H1-H4 primary endpoints only after margins are frozen

studies.claim: Consumer conditioning changes the minimum feasible memory representation
studies.endpoint: consumer-by-representation interaction and distinct feasible sets at calibrated task tolerances
studies.falsification: a common fixed representation meets all contracts with indistinguishable resource cost
studies.gate: consumer outputs and losses validated; train/calibration/test split frozen

studies.claim: Unknown reversible addressing harms a spatial reader and a retained inverse restores utility
studies.endpoint: paired task-output loss difference and recovery equivalence with a predeclared tolerance
studies.falsification: recovery fails, or the supposed spatial consumer is invariant to the intervention
studies.gate: correctness before timing; pooling analyzed separately

studies.claim: Layout strategies occupy different feasible storage-latency-energy points under specified workloads
studies.endpoint: paired lifecycle median differences and resource feasibility; latency and energy analyzed separately
studies.falsification: reindex is practically equivalent throughout the deployment range; preservation is downgraded
studies.gate: paired kernel capabilities, hardware-counter availability and practical-equivalence margins frozen
studies.execution: screening factorial followed by independently collected confirmatory boundary points; no assumed crossing

studies.claim: FRAME improves a closed-loop task-resource frontier under a learned world-action model
studies.full_study: expand to LIBERO suites only after pilot; sample size selected from minimum effect and task-level pilot variance
studies.replication: RoboTwin: 5-10 preselected tasks, compatible bimanual learned model required
studies.endpoint: equal-task paired success/resource frontier; hierarchical task-then-state resampling
studies.falsification: no nondominated improvement, quality-constraint violations, or gains disappear with matched decoders and sensing
